# Change summary

## Description

Describe the problem and resulting behavior, with a concrete before/after example when useful. For scaffolding or design changes, distinguish proposed capabilities from implemented behavior.

## Related issues

Link actual related issues, or state that none apply.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Record relevant OS/tool versions and distinguish documentation/static checks, automated tests, native application acceptance, and live-server evidence. Explain checks not run and why.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe affected protocols, interfaces, plugins, or stored data and any migration requirements. State material limitations or assumptions.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes stay within the requested scope and preserve unrelated work.
- [ ] Applicable root and nested agent instructions were followed.
- [ ] Documentation and status claims match the current implementation.
- [ ] Relevant checks were completed, or omissions are explained above.
- [ ] Evidence contains no credentials, private transcripts, or live profiles.
